profile.headline: Full Stack Web Developer
profile.geoLocationName: South San Francisco, California, United States
profile.summary: Experienced software engineer specializing in full stack web development with a track record of success at global technology companies and venture-funded startups. Built and deployed custom web applications supporting an international audience of PlayStation consumer content developers at Sony Interactive Entertainment and data analytics professionals at Electronic Arts. Contributed to numerous production-related projects involving continuous deployment, build automation, and cloud infrastructure. Graduated from the Berkeley Coding Boot Camp full stack developer course in 2018. Studied Management Science & Engineering at Stanford University.

positions.title: Full Stack Web Developer
positions.locationName: San Mateo, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Developed full stack applications using PHP, MySQL, and JavaScript as part of a cross-functional team supporting PlayStation consumer content initiatives.

Designed new features and application architecture for legacy and greenfield codebases.

Built and maintained databases, APIs, and dynamic server-side content to support application performance and functionality.

Investigated bug reports and contributed to technical discussions to help improve developer experience and productivity.

Contributed to monthly reports and various workgroup initiatives.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: South San Francisco, California, United States · Remote
positions.description:
Upwork - Built web pages, debugged UI components and implemented SEO optimizations.

Scale AI - Performed grading and analysis on AI-generated responses involving programming and computer science topics.

Portfolio projects - Built full-stack web applications using Node, TypeScript, Express, React and public API data. Available on www.josephikim.com.
positions.insights: Skills: Node.js · TypeScript · Express.js · API Development · React.js · JavaScript

positions.locationName: Redwood City, California, United States · On-site

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Built and deployed custom web applications that enabled cross-functional data analytics teams to perform various tasks including data visualization, automated reporting, collaborative project management, knowledge sharing and evaluation of open source analytics tools.

Assembled CI/CD pipelines integrating repository hooks, automated testing suites and cloud infrastructure services to lower deployment time and engineering overhead.

Utilized industry-leading services for production-related tasks such as bug reporting, performance monitoring and web analytics.

Published technical documentation and contributed to team discussions involving architecture design for development of new features and greenfield projects.

Conducted regular code reviews, participated in agile process improvements and helped establish team coding guidelines.

positions.title: Analytics Knowledge Sharing Site Specialist
positions.description:
Managed on-premise and cloud-based deployments of knowledge management software serving a global audience of data analytics professionals.

Collaborated with analytics leaders to plan and execute knowledge sharing initiatives involving creation of web pages, custom HTML emails and technical documentation.

Assisted the Director of Operations and Head of Player Data on a variety of project management tasks involving goal tracking, employee training and corporate communications.

Consulted with end users to resolve technical issues, conducted live software demos and maintained online support channels.

positions.title: Language QA Analyst
positions.description:
Performed grading and analysis on pre-production assets at the user interface testing level.

Reported QA testing results and assisted on projects involving metadata, ticket resolution and version control. 

Collaborated with data engineers and international language specialists to ensure execution of quality test schedules.

positions.title: Content Management Intern
positions.description:
Sourced targeted online career opportunities and qualifying contacts.

Conducted fact-checking and drafted copy for featured site content.

Managed live postings via internal CMS.

positions.title: Evangelist (Sales)
positions.description:
Supported sales and marketing executives in planning and executing custom online advertising campaigns on leading social media networks. 

Created reports on user engagement and campaign performance using web analytics tools. 

Assisted in the development of marketing campaigns and user testing.
